explanation.en: Two nouns chained: the first (mudaf) never takes الـ or tanwin; the second (mudaf ilayh) is always majrur and supplies the definiteness. مُعَلِّمِهِ = مُعَلِّم + ه: "his teacher" — definite because of the pronoun, though مُعَلِّم itself carries no الـ. An attached pronoun (ـه، ـي…) counts as a mudaf ilayh in the position of jarr.

why.en: The mudaf never takes الـ — definiteness flows up from the mudaf ilayh.
The mudaf also never takes tanwin — tanwin and idafa exclude each other.
